description: An expander that scrolls, turns, mirrors, inverts and randomises the memory of the module immediately to its right; the number printed at the top is how many memory channels it has found

params.text: Scales the scroll amount input, -32 to 32 cells for each 10V, before the scroll amount knob is added
Sets how many cells each scroll moves the picture, 0 to 32
Inverts every cell of every memory channel once, in the way the switch beside it sets
Chooses how a value is inverted: -x turns it negative, 10-x subtracts it from 10V; a memory of on-and-off cells is flipped either way
Sets the highest voltage a randomise may write, -10V to 10V
Fills every cell of every memory channel with a fresh random value once
Sets the lowest voltage a randomise may write, -10V to 10V; on a memory of on-and-off cells this trimpot alone sets the chance of a cell coming out on, never at -10V and always at 10V
Makes a scroll carry cells round from one edge to the other; switched off, cells pushed past an edge are replaced with 0 and the ones brought in are blank

inputs.text: Scrolls the picture up and to the left by the scroll amount, on each rising edge above 1V
Scrolls the picture up by the scroll amount, on each rising edge above 1V
Scrolls the picture up and to the right by the scroll amount, on each rising edge above 1V
Scrolls the picture to the left by the scroll amount, on each rising edge above 1V
Scrolls the picture to the right by the scroll amount, on each rising edge above 1V
Scrolls the picture down and to the left by the scroll amount, on each rising edge above 1V
Scrolls the picture down by the scroll amount, on each rising edge above 1V
Scrolls the picture down and to the right by the scroll amount, on each rising edge above 1V
Sets how far a scroll moves, through the scroll trimpot and added to the scroll knob, with the total held between -64 and 64 cells
Turns the picture a quarter turn clockwise on each rising edge above 1V, and does nothing on a memory that is not square
Turns the picture a quarter turn anticlockwise on each rising edge above 1V, and does nothing on a memory that is not square
Turns the picture upside down on each rising edge above 1V
Mirrors the picture from left to right on each rising edge above 1V
Inverts every cell on each rising edge above 1V, in the way the inversion switch sets
Fills every cell with fresh random values on each rising edge above 1V

notes: this module does nothing on its own: it works on the memory of a DMA-compatible module placed immediately to its right, which means RAM-40964, Microcosm or Dual Integrator
a single-channel cable on any of these trigger jacks acts on every memory channel at once; a polyphonic cable acts on them one for one, its first channel on the first memory channel and so on
the green lamp says the memory found is square and can be turned, and the red one says it is not
a scroll of a whole row or column can be built by turning the scroll knob up, and a negative total from the scroll input reverses the direction the jack is named for
with no DMA-compatible module immediately to its right the number at the top reads 0 and none of the jacks has any effect
